14: export async function authenticate(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> {
15:   try {
16:     const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
17:     
18:     if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
19:       res.status(401).json({ error: 'Authentication required' });
20:       return;
21:     }
22: 
23:     const token = authHeader.substring(7);
24:     const user = await authService.verifyToken(token);
25:     
26:     req.user = user;
27:     next();
28:   } catch (error) {
29:     if (error instanceof AppError) {
30:       res.status(error.statusCode).json({ error: error.message });
31:       return;
32:     }
33:     
34:     res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
35:   }
36: }
37: 
38: export function authorize(...roles: string[]) {
39:   return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
40:     if (!req.user) {
41:       res.status(401).json({ error: 'Authentication required' });
42:       return;
43:     }
44: 
45:     if (roles.length > 0 && !roles.includes(req.user.role)) {
46:       res.status(403).json({ error: 'Insufficient permissions' });
47:       return;
48:     }
49: 
50:     next();
51:   };
52: }

54: export function authorizeTaskOwnerOrAdmin(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
55:   if (!req.user) {
56:     res.status(401).json({ error: 'Authentication required' });
57:     return;
58:   }
59: 
60:   if (req.user.role === 'admin') {
61:     next();
62:     return;
63:   }
64: 
65:   const taskId = req.params.id;
66:   if (!taskId) {
67:     res.status(400).json({ error: 'Task ID required' });
68:     return;
69:   }
70: 
71:   taskRepository.findById(taskId)
72:     .then(task => {
73:       if (!task) {
74:         res.status(404).json({ error: 'Task not found' });
75:         return;
76:       }
77: 
78:       if (task.userId !== req.user!.id) {
79:         res.status(403).json({ error: 'Insufficient permissions' });
80:         return;
81:       }
82: 
83:       next();
84:     })

86:       res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });

1: import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
2: import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
3: import { authConfig } from '../config/auth.js';
4: import { userRepository } from '../repositories/userRepository.js';
5: import { sessionRepository } from '../repositories/sessionRepository.js';
6: import { CreateUserInput, UserModel, UserResponse, toUserResponse } from '../models/user.js';
7: 
8: export interface AuthResult {
9:   user: UserResponse;
10:   token: string;
11:   refreshToken: string;
12: }
13: 
14: export interface LoginInput {
15:   email: string;
16:   password: string;
17: }
18: 
19: export class AuthService {
20:   async register(input: CreateUserInput): Promise<AuthResult> {
21:     const existingUser = await userRepository.findByEmail(input.email);
22:     if (existingUser) {
23:       throw new AppError('Email already registered', 409);
24:     }
25: 
26:     const user = await userRepository.create(input);
27:     const token = this.generateToken(user);
28:     const refreshToken = await this.createSession(user.id);
29: 
30:     return {
31:       user: toUserResponse(user),
32:       token,
33:       refreshToken,
34:     };
35:   }
36: 
37:   async login(input: LoginInput): Promise<AuthResult> {
38:     const user = await userRepository.findByEmail(input.email);
39:     if (!user) {
40:       throw new AppError('Invalid email or password', 401);
41:     }
42: 
43:     if (!user.isActive) {
44:       throw new AppError('Account is deactivated', 403);
45:     }
46: 
47:     const isValidPassword = await bcrypt.compare(input.password, user.passwordHash);
48:     if (!isValidPassword) {
49:       throw new AppError('Invalid email or password', 401);
50:     }
51: 
52:     const token = this.generateToken(user);
53:     const refreshToken = await this.createSession(user.id);
54: 
55:     return {
56:       user: toUserResponse(user),
57:       token,
58:       refreshToken,
59:     };
60:   }
61: 
62:   async logout(token: string): Promise<void> {
63:     await sessionRepository.delete(token);
64:   }
65: 
66:   async refreshToken(refreshToken: string): Promise<AuthResult> {
67:     const session = await sessionRepository.findByToken(refreshToken);
68:     if (!session) {
69:       throw new AppError('Invalid refresh token', 401);
70:     }
71: 
72:     const user = await userRepository.findById(session.userId);
73:     if (!user || !user.isActive) {
74:       throw new AppError('User not found or deactivated', 401);
75:     }
76: 
77:     await sessionRepository.delete(refreshToken);
78: 
79:     const newToken = this.generateToken(user);
80:     const newRefreshToken = await this.createSession(user.id);
81: 
82:     return {
83:       user: toUserResponse(user),
84:       token: newToken,
85:       refreshToken: newRefreshToken,
86:     };
87:   }
88: 
89:   async verifyToken(token: string): Promise<UserModel> {
90:     try {
91:       const payload = jwt.verify(token, authConfig.jwtSecret) as { userId: string };
92:       const user = await userRepository.findById(payload.userId);
93:       
94:       if (!user) {
95:         throw new AppError('User not found', 401);
96:       }
97: 
98:       if (!user.isActive) {
99:         throw new AppError('Account is deactivated', 403);
100:       }
101: 
102:       return user;
103:     } catch (error) {
104:       if (error instanceof AppError) {
105:         throw error;
106:       }
107:       throw new AppError('Invalid token', 401);
108:     }
109:   }
110: 
111:   async changePassword(userId: string, currentPassword: string, newPassword: string): Promise<void> {
112:     const user = await userRepository.findById(userId);
113:     if (!user) {
114:       throw new AppError('User not found', 404);
115:     }
116: 
117:     const isValidPassword = await bcrypt.compare(currentPassword, user.passwordHash);
118:     if (!isValidPassword) {
119:       throw new AppError('Current password is incorrect', 401);
120:     }
121: 
122:     await userRepository.updatePassword(userId, newPassword);
123:   }
124: 
125:   private generateToken(user: UserModel): string {
126:     return jwt.sign(
127:       { userId: user.id, email: user.email, role: user.role },
128:       authConfig.jwtSecret,
129:       { expiresIn: authConfig.jwtExpiresIn }
130:     );
131:   }
132: 
133:   private async createSession(userId: string): Promise<string> {
134:     const token = await sessionRepository.generateToken();
135:     const expiresAt = new Date();
136:     expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 7);
137: 
138:     await sessionRepository.create(userId, token, expiresAt);
139:     return token;
140:   }
141: }

144:   constructor(
145:     message: string,
146:     public statusCode: number,
147:     public code?: string
148:   ) {
149:     super(message);
150:     this.name = 'AppError';
151:   }
152: }
153: 
154: export const authService = new AuthService();

16: export function getPool(): Pool {
17:   if (!pool) {
18:     pool = new Pool(poolConfig);
19:     
20:     pool.on('error', (err) => {
21:       console.error('Unexpected error on idle client', err);
22:     });
23:   }
24:   return pool;
25: }

28:   if (pool) {
29:     await pool.end();
30:     pool = null;
31:   }
32: }

34: export async function query<T = any>(text: string, params?: any[]): Promise<T[]> {
35:   const client = await getPool().connect();
36:   try {
37:     const result = await client.query(text, params);
38:     return result.rows as T[];
39:   } finally {
40:     client.release();
41:   }

45:   const rows = await query<T>(text, params);
46:   return rows[0] || null;
47: }

49: export async function transaction<T>(callback: (client: any) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
50:   const client = await getPool().connect();
51:   try {
52:     await client.query('BEGIN');
53:     const result = await callback(client);
54:     await client.query('COMMIT');
55:     return result;
56:   } catch (error) {
57:     await client.query('ROLLBACK');
58:     throw error;
59:   } finally {
60:     client.release();
61:   }
